evidence.title: GitHub - tdw46/blender-animated-ui: Reusable animated preview thumbnail engine and FFmpeg ingest demo for Blender extensions · GitHub

name: blender-animated-ui
summary: Reusable animated preview thumbnail engine and FFmpeg ingest demo for Blender extensions.
description: A reusable example library for adding efficient animated preview thumbnails to Blender extensions. It turns GIFs, APNGs, videos, still images and selected image sequences into timed JPEG/WebP frame caches, then plays those frames in a normal Blender N-panel gallery through bpy.utils.previews, with a shared modal scheduler, a 32 MiB default preview-RAM budget, adaptive pagination, close-safe animated dialogs and copy-in integration profiles (playback only, ingest only or the complete demo).
contains: turns GIF, APNG, video, stills and image sequences into JPEG/WebP frame caches
plays frames in a Blender N-panel gallery via bpy.utils.previews
one guarded modal scheduler; only visible gallery cards animate
32 MiB default preview-RAM target with adaptive pagination
integration profiles: playback only, ingest only, complete demo
bundles imageio-ffmpeg 0.6.0 and Pillow 12.3.0 wheels for offline install
settings cog: thumbnail sizing, RAM control, 8-60 FPS live ceiling, optimized playback
installs in Blender 4.2+ via Preferences > Get Extensions from a GitHub Releases ZIP
